changes.comment: Tool calls now carry display facts derived from the built-in tool's input: a Bash call is labelled by its description (or the first line of its command) with the command line as the invocation; Read/Write/Edit/NotebookEdit by their path, which is also the call's one item; Grep/Glob/WebSearch/ToolSearch by their pattern or query; Agent by its description with the task text as the invocation; Skill by the skill name; WebFetch by its URL. MCP and other unknown tools report no label. The tool vocabulary now lives in one module (tool-display.ts).
